operations.description: The alias scan could not tell an AGENT reference from a slash-command of the same name, so cluster 4 -- which merges the doc-updater agent away while /doc-updater the command survives -- turned `ck doctor --strict` red on two files that are both correct. Two exemptions, each exactly one shape wide: the command file whose own name is the alias key, and `/<name>` occurrences, which are command references by construction. The scan still flags a bare or backticked agent reference anywhere.
